name: riftline-weapon-tools
description: Offline pipeline that turns the source Sketchfab GLBs into the game-ready viewmodels in public/models.

scripts.build: node build.mjs ak ../../public/models/ak.glb && node build.mjs glock ../../public/models/glock.glb && node build.mjs sniper ../../public/models/sniper.glb
